title: FigureSpec
description: Declarative spec for one publication figure, living at intracardiac-platform/project/phases/phase_X/figure_specs/<id>.json. Schema version 1. The spec file is the git-tracked source of truth; the rendered image (output.path, pointing into the paper repo) is gitignored build output regenerated by egm-studio's headless figure-render CLI. The required `description` records why the figure exists so a forgotten figure can be re-evaluated (keep / discard) without re-deriving its purpose. `recipe` names one of egm-studio's figure recipes; recipe-specific fields live under `inputs` (kept permissive here because the recipe vocabulary is owned by egm-studio, not hardcoded into the contract). The figure does not declare which phase it belongs to — that membership is recorded by the phase manifest that points at it. See cross_artifact_linkage_design.md section 5.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

description.description: REQUIRED human-readable explanation of what this figure shows and why it was generated. Ensures a figure that was made and then forgotten can be revisited, understood, and either used or discarded.

recipe.description: Name of the egm-studio figure recipe that renders this figure (e.g. 'feature-distribution-overlay'). Free-form string: the recipe vocabulary is owned + validated by egm-studio, not enumerated in the contract.

inputs.description: Recipe-specific inputs. Permissive (additionalProperties true) because the schema discriminates on `recipe` at the egm-studio layer. Well-known key: `groups` (array of {name, bank_id}) for overlay-style recipes.

groups.description: Named data groups for overlay/comparison recipes.

name.description: Human-readable group label shown in the legend.

bank_id.description: Stable id of the bank supplying this group's data.

layout.description: Recipe-specific layout (panel grid, per-panel size, ...). Permissive.

output.description: Where + how the rendered figure is written.

format.description: Output format. Vector PDF is the default for paper figures.

path.description: Output path for the rendered image, typically pointing OUT of the meta repo into the paper repo. Gitignored at the destination; regenerated at paper-build time.

illustrates_observations.description: OPTIONAL observation ids this figure illustrates. Drives the manifest entry's consumes_observations field. Optional because not every figure illustrates a specific observation.
